content: .{@-अभवन्मतयोगः, -संयोगः@} (in <ab>Rhet.</ab>) a defect in composition; अभवन् असंभवन्नपि मतः इष्टः योगः सम्बन्धः यत्र <ls>K. P. 7</ls>; the ‘failure of an intended connection’, or want of harmony between the ideas to be expressed and the words expressing them; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} ईक्षसे यत्कटाक्षेण तदा धन्वी मनोभवः, here the word यत् can have no {%Correlation%} with तदा though intended by the poet. The proper reading would be ईक्षसे चेत् <ab>&c.</ab>; for other examples see <ls>S. D. 575</ls> {%ad loc.%}
